title: Think Big
description: A Mediterranean mantis (Iris oratoria) clings to a plant, stretching out its arms and legs in a defensive display. As a survival strategy, mantises try to make themselves appear as large and imposing as possible to potential predators. The Mediterranean mantis is particularly quick to become defensive—even when a photographer gets too close.
translated_description: 一只地中海螳螂（Iris oratoria）紧附在植物上，伸展开它的手臂和腿，摆出防御姿态。作为一种生存策略，螳螂会尽量让自己在潜在捕食者面前显得尽可能大而威猛。地中海螳螂尤其容易进入防御状态——甚至当摄影师靠得太近时也是如此。
